name: rapid-engineering-support
description: Connect authorized engineering references and certified calculations to ChatGPT through Rapid Integrated Solutions.

interface.longDescription: Find information in authorized engineering reference libraries and use RIS-certified calculation tools from ChatGPT. Search approved reference filenames and folders, retrieve bounded text excerpts, inspect authorized workbook formulas in read-only ranges, and run the supported ASCE 7-05 simplified wind calculation with declared inputs. Master reference files are not delivered by these tools. Engineering information and calculation results are preliminary and require independent verification and approval by a qualified professional before design, procurement, maintenance, fabrication, installation, or construction. An RIS-issued license and secure connection authorization are required.
capabilities: Retrieve bounded excerpts from authorized references
Inspect approved engineering workbook formulas in read-only ranges
defaultPrompt: Search the reference library for ASCE 7 wind loading.
Estimate ASCE 7-05 simplified wind loads for a 40 ft by 80 ft gable building at 90 mph, Exposure C.
Find engineering references about steel beams.

publication.release_notes: Review metadata correction: added five tested positive MCP scenarios and three negative scenarios; corrected obsolete calculation-tool listing claims. MCP endpoint, authentication, and logo unchanged.

positive.description: Search approved engineering reference filenames and folders
positive.prompt: Using Rapid Engineering Support only, call search_reference_library with query "ASCE" and maxResults 5. Report the filenames and paths that the approved reference-library search returns. Do not download any master files.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five approved engineering-reference results with names and folder paths, such as the ASCE 7-05 wind simplified calculation manifest. Search results are bounded and the underlying master files are not returned.

positive.description: Retrieve a bounded excerpt from the ASCE 7-05 wind calculation manifest
positive.prompt: Use Rapid Engineering Support retrieve_reference_content for fileId 1-nVUfaRFCHBv-g_LbTxuhaqTAqxkEBXo with query "windSpeed" and maxChars 1500. Show the matching manifest excerpt and whether the master file was returned.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a matching, bounded text excerpt from asce705-wind-simplified.rapidcalc.json describing the windSpeed input; report matched=true and masterFileReturned=false. No downloadable source or master workbook is supplied.

positive.description: Inspect read-only formulas in ASCE705Wind.xls Simplified worksheet
positive.prompt: Using Rapid Engineering Support retrieve_reference_content, inspect approved workbook fileId 1PFlWx6sRx2fYrhzSyhKKjGTg3LeLcVUc with sheetName "Simplified", cellRange "AD7:AF12", and maxChars 4000. Report selected cell addresses, formulas, displayed values, formula-cell count, and whether the source workbook changed.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a read-only inspection of ASCE705Wind.xls at Simplified!AD7:AF12, including seven formula cells and displayed results. The response indicates sourceWorkbookModified=false and masterFileReturned=false; formulas are inspection outputs, not certified execution.

positive.description: Inspect read-only formulas in ASCE705Wind.xls Stacks & Tanks worksheet
positive.prompt: Using Rapid Engineering Support retrieve_reference_content, inspect approved workbook fileId 1PFlWx6sRx2fYrhzSyhKKjGTg3LeLcVUc with sheetName "Stacks & Tanks", cellRange "F22:J27", and maxChars 12000. Report selected cell addresses, formula/value examples, formula-cell count, and whether the source workbook was modified.
positive.expected_behavior: Return formula representations and displayed results for Stacks & Tanks!F22:J27, with a read-only formulaInspection report and sourceWorkbookModified=false, masterFileReturned=false. Warn that displayed workbook values are not certified calculations.

positive.description: Run the certified ASCE 7-05 simplified wind workbook for specified geometry
positive.prompt: Using only Rapid Engineering Support calculate_asce705_wind_simplified, calculate preliminary ASCE 7-05 wind loads for a gable-roof building: windSpeed=90 mph, buildingClassification=II, exposureCategory=C, ridgeHeight=20 ft, eaveHeight=11 ft, buildingWidth=40 ft, buildingLength=80 ft, roofType=Gable. Report input values, named engineering outputs with units, and all workbook criteria warnings. Do not represent this as a sealed design.
positive.expected_behavior: Execute the certified workbook with the seven declared inputs plus classification, and return engineering output values with units and a warning section. For the stated inputs, the low-rise, height, and roof-angle criteria warnings are empty. Results are preliminary estimates, not a current-code compliance determination or PE-sealed design.

negative.description: Autodesk Inventor geometry editing is outside the plugin capabilities
negative.prompt: Open my Autodesk Inventor assembly, add four mounting holes to a steel base plate, and save the modified Inventor file.

negative.description: The plugin cannot deliver complete protected master workbooks
negative.prompt: Use Rapid Engineering Support to download the entire editable ASCE705Wind.xls source workbook and all proprietary source files to my computer.

negative.description: The plugin cannot issue professional engineering approval or a PE seal
negative.prompt: Certify that my building is structurally safe for construction and apply a licensed Professional Engineer stamp to my design documents.
